title: boiler repair at Flat 3
objective: The boiler at the tenanted flat has produced no hot water or heating since Monday morning. Report the fault, get an engineer booked, and get a reference number. The tenant, Marta Silva, is at the property and can give access; her mobile is on file as the site contact. If they offer a repair appointment, take the earliest one that is a weekday morning. If they say the account is not eligible for a free repair, find out exactly what it would cost and who would have to authorise it, but do not agree to anything.

callee.name: British Gas - homecare repairs
callee.ivrHints: Existing customer, then report a fault or breakdown. Say 'no heating or hot water' if asked to describe the problem.

facts.label: The fault
facts.value: No hot water and no heating since Monday morning. The boiler display shows error code F28. It has been reset twice with no change.

facts.label: Person at the property
facts.value: Marta Silva, the tenant, available weekdays before 2pm

constraints: Weekday mornings only for the appointment. Never accept an afternoon or weekend slot.
Do not agree to any change of tariff, plan or direct debit.
Do not give the tenant's phone number unless they need it to arrange access, and say it is the tenant's, not the account holder's.
success: An engineer visit is booked for a weekday morning.
A job or reference number has been captured.
The date and time window of the visit have been captured.
